(.env): Your private settings (database address, passwords, keys). Not in Git on purpose: you create it yourself. See chapter 4.
(node_modules/): Downloaded packages, created by npm install. Never edit it and never commit it; delete it and run npm install again if it breaks.
.gitignore: Tells Git which files to leave out: node_modules/, .env, logs, .vscode/ and any folder called images/.
.sequelizerc: Tells the Sequelize command-line tool where the config, models and migrations live (inside src/).
package.json: The project's ID card: its name, the npm run commands (scripts) and the list of packages it needs.
package-lock.json: The exact version of every package that was installed, so every computer gets the same ones. Written by npm; don't edit by hand.
render.yaml: Instructions for Render (the hosting company): how to build and start the site and which settings to ask for.
start-windows.bat: Double-click starter for Windows: checks Node.js, installs packages the first time, then runs npm start.
README.md: The project's front page on GitHub: what SeniorPadi does, how to run it, the settings table and the deployment plan.
HANDOVER.md: A no-code guide for the person who runs the live site day to day (Render, Neon, Brevo, Cloudinary, the admin pages).
DESIGN-NOTES.md: Why the site looks the way it does: the design references, palette, contrast checks and what changed in each redesign pass.
IMAGE_CREDITS.md: Every picture used, where it is used, why it fits, its licence status, and a shopping list for better photos.
docs/MVP.md: The original project write-up (the first version, its features and design screenshots).
docs/ui-revamp/GUIDE.md: The plan for the accessibility-first redesign (phases 0 to 3) and how the work was split up.
docs/ui-revamp/audit.md: Phase 0: a list of every page and the problems found before the redesign.
docs/ui-revamp/research.md: Phase 1: design research (palettes, layouts, accessibility standards, the Yorùbá font test).
docs/ui-revamp/palette.md: Phase 2: the chosen colour palette and its measured contrast.
docs/ui-revamp/design-spec.md: Phase 3: the design rules every restyled page had to follow.
docs/ui-revamp/phase3-results.md: Phase 3: before-and-after results of the full restyle.
Raw output of the colour-contrast checker.
docs/ui-revamp/agents/*: Short briefs for the helper roles used during the redesign (reviewer, accessibility, tests and so on). Not used by the app.
docs/ui-revamp/tools/preview-server.mjs: Preview server: shows every page with made-up data and no database, at http://localhost:4100/__pages.
docs/ui-revamp/tools/start-preview.bat: Double-click starter for the preview server on Windows.
docs/ui-revamp/tools/contrast.mjs: Checks that text and background colours have enough contrast to read.
docs/ui-revamp/tools/page-checks.js: A script pasted into a browser to check a page's layout (tap-target sizes, overflow and so on).
docs/ui-revamp/tools/content-freeze.mjs: Checks that a restyle did not change any words, links or form fields.
docs/ui-revamp/tools/freeze-approved.jso: The list of word/field changes that were approved during the redesign (read by content-freeze.mjs).
locales/en.json: Every English sentence on the site, each with a key like "login.submit". Change wording here.
locales/yo.json: The same keys in Yorùbá. If a key is missing here, the English one is shown.
public/css/main.css: The finished stylesheet the browser downloads. Built from src/styles/input.css; never edit it by hand.
public/fonts/outfit-variable.woff2: The Outfit font file (all weights in one file), served from our own site.
public/fonts/README.txt: Where the Outfit font comes from and its licence.
public/images/README.md: Notes on the pictures in this folder (some of it is older than IMAGE_CREDITS.md; trust IMAGE_CREDITS.md first).
public/images/hero.png: An older hero picture. Nothing links to it any more.
public/images/events/*: Cover photo for each event category (fitness, faith, learning, skills, social, health), as JPG and smaller WebP.
public/images/illustrations/*: Small original SVG drawings (elders chatting, a calendar, a phone and so on) used on several pages.
public/js/ui.js: Shared page helpers: pop-ups, the show/hide password eye, busy buttons, confirm-password check, log-out question.
public/js/otp.js: The six code boxes and the resend countdown on the Confirm-your-phone page.
public/js/phone-input.js: Keeps phone boxes to numbers only, 11 digits.
public/js/top-loader.js: The thin progress bar at the top while the next page loads.
public/js/dialog.js: Keyboard and screen-reader help for pop-ups (log in, "you're registered", requests).
public/js/swipe.js: Swipe cards on Find events and Find seniors: drag right for yes, left to skip.
public/js/chat.js: Makes new chat messages appear without reloading (uses Socket.IO).
public/js/dashboard.js: Refreshes the numbers on the staff dashboard every 20 seconds.
public/js/upload.js: Changes an upload button's text while a file is being sent.
src/server.js: The starting point. Checks settings, connects to the database, updates it, then opens the website.
src/app.js: Builds the Express app: chooses EJS, serves public/, adds the middleware and plugs in every route file.
src/config/config.js: Database settings for Sequelize and its command-line tool.
src/config/database.js: Picks which database to use (local, Neon, Render or test) and whether it needs SSL.
src/config/session.js: The login session: stored in the database, cookie lasts 30 days.
src/middleware/locals.js: Runs on every request: finds the logged-in user, the language, translations and flash messages for the views.
src/middleware/auth.js: Gatekeepers: must be logged in, must be staff, must have changed a reset password, must be ID-verified.
src/middleware/csrf.js: Adds a secret token to every form and rejects forms without it (protects against fake forms on other sites).
src/middleware/rateLimit.js: Limits how often someone can try to log in, sign up, reset a password, upload or send messages.
src/middleware/numericId.js: Turns addresses like /events/abc into a friendly "not found" page.
src/middleware/upload.js: Receives uploaded pictures, ID documents and videos (in memory) and checks their type and size.
src/models/index.js: Connects to the database, loads every model and says how tables relate (an event belongs to an organization...).
src/models/user.js: The Users table: name, phone, email, password hash, role (senior or admin), language, ID status and more.
src/models/event.js: The Events table: title, description, dates, place, category, capacity, volunteers, status.
src/models/registration.js: The Registrations table: who is going to which event, as attendee or volunteer, with a ticket number.
src/models/organization.js: The Organizations table: the churches, clubs and centres that host events.
src/models/eventInterest.js: "Tell me when a similar event is listed" requests.
src/models/passwordReset.js: One-time password-reset links (only a hash of the link is stored).
src/models/auditLog.js: A record of important staff actions and failed messages.
src/models/skip.js: Seniors someone skipped in Find seniors, so they don't show again.
src/models/report.js: Reports a senior made about someone, for staff to review.
src/models/reportHide.js: Hides a reported senior from the person who reported them.
src/models/notification.js: In-app notifications (new message, ID result, staff alerts).
src/models/onboardingVideo.js: The welcome video and its written transcript, one per language.
src/models/attendance.js: Who actually came to an event.
src/models/phoneExchange.js: "Can we swap phone numbers?" requests between two seniors.
src/models/verificationCode.js: The 6-digit codes sent to confirm a phone number or email.
src/models/translation.js: Saved Google Translate results, so each text is only translated once.
src/migrations/20260928000001-create-soc: Migration: creates the messaging, skip, block, report and notification tables.
src/migrations/20260929000001-phase3.js: Migration: creates the OnboardingVideos table and adds onboardingSeenAt (Users) and qrToken (Registrations).
src/migrations/20261003000001-events-tic: Migration: adds ticket numbers, phone/email confirmation dates and reminder switches, plus the Attendances, PhoneExchanges, VerificationCodes and Translations tables.
src/routes/public.js: Pages anyone can open: Home, About, Call, language switch, sign up, log in/out, forgot/reset/change password, /health.
src/routes/events.js: Find events (one card at a time), one event's page, Register, Volunteer, the "you're registered" pop-up, Notify me.
src/routes/verify.js: Confirm your phone (and email) with a 6-digit code before joining events or messaging.
src/routes/account.js: My account, my registrations (and cancelling), history, settings, profile picture, delete account.
src/routes/social.js: Find seniors, ID upload, skip, report, block, messages, phone exchange and notifications.
src/routes/onboarding.js: The welcome video shown once after signing up.
src/routes/admin.js: Every staff page under /admin: dashboard, events, organizations, attendance, seniors, IDs, reports, staff, system.
src/services/startup.js: Start-up checks: settings, waiting for the database, the welcome text, the first admin, the stylesheet.
src/services/migrate.js: Applies new database migrations when the app starts and recreates missing tables.
src/services/capacity.js: Counts seats and registers people safely so an event can never be overbooked.
src/services/registration.js: Registers a senior and sends the confirmation text/email; also safeNext for safe redirects.
src/services/notify.js: Sends SMS and email through Brevo (or prints them in the terminal when Brevo isn't set up).
src/services/verification.js: Creates and checks the 6-digit confirmation codes.
src/services/i18n.js: The t() function that looks up a sentence in English or Yorùbá.
src/services/dates.js: Shows dates and times in Lagos time and converts form dates.
src/services/phone.js: Checks and tidies Nigerian phone numbers (08031234567 → +2348031234567).
src/services/translate.js: Translates event text into Yorùbá with Google Translate (optional) and caches it.
src/services/cloudinary.js: Uploads pictures, IDs and videos to Cloudinary and makes signed links to view IDs.
src/services/cron.js: Scheduled jobs: reminder texts at 8am, and marking finished events as completed every hour.
src/services/social.js: Rules for who can see and message whom (verified, not blocked, not skipped).
src/services/messaging.js: Sends a chat message (used by the normal form and by live chat, so the rules match).
src/services/phoneExchange.js: The rules for asking to swap phone numbers and answering.
src/services/attendance.js: Records who came to an event (list, QR scan or ticket number all end here).
src/services/removal.js: The two ways to remove a senior (from Find seniors only, or delete the account).
src/services/qr.js: Makes the optional QR check-in code picture.
src/services/audit.js: Writes one line to the audit log, and never crashes a request.
src/sockets/index.js: Live chat with Socket.IO: only verified seniors, same login session as the website.
src/scripts/seed.js: npm run seed: wipes the database and fills it with demo events and users.
src/scripts/checkDb.js: npm run db:check: says which database the app will use and whether it can reach it.
src/scripts/createAdmin.js: npm run create-admin: makes a staff account from the command line.
src/scripts/translateUi.js: npm run translate:ui: fills missing Yorùbá text in locales/yo.json with Google Translate.
src/styles/input.css: The stylesheet you edit: Tailwind setup, brand colours (@theme), fonts and every shared class.
tests/helpers.js: Shared helpers for the tests (make a test senior, a test event, log in).
tests/capacity.test.js: Tests that events can never be overbooked, even with many people at once.
tests/features.test.js: Tests tickets, confirming a phone, swapping numbers, attendance, the dashboard, filters, reminders and translation.
tests/newui.test.js: Tests the newer screens (Find events cards, Skip, the registered pop-up).
tests/phase3.test.js: Tests live chat (Socket.IO) safety, QR check-in and the one-time welcome guide.
tests/routes.test.js: Tests that pages open, forms work without JavaScript and seniors can't open staff pages.
tests/social.test.js: Tests messaging, blocking, reporting and ID rules.
tests/startup.test.js: Tests that the app can set up an empty database on its own.
views/home.ejs: Home: the hero, the three big choices, Events near you, How it works.
views/call.ejs: Call SeniorPadi: the support phone number and hours.
views/error.ejs: The friendly error page (not found, not allowed, something went wrong).
views/onboarding.ejs: The welcome video and transcript after signing up.
views/auth/verify.ejs: Confirm your phone (and email) with a 6-digit code.
views/auth/reset.ejs: Choose a new password from an email link.
views/auth/change.ejs: Change password (forced after staff reset it).
views/events/index.ejs: Find events: one event card at a time with Register and Skip.
views/events/registered.ejs: The "you're registered" pop-up (with the volunteer offer).
views/events/confirmed.ejs: Confirmation page with the optional QR code.
views/account/account.ejs: My account (the hub for everything personal).
views/account/registrations.ejs: My events: tickets and Cancel buttons.
views/account/settings.ejs: Settings: details, language, reminders, profile picture.
views/social/find.ejs: Find seniors: one senior at a time, or the ID upload if not verified yet.
views/social/thread.ejs: One conversation, with the phone-swap button.
views/admin/event-form.ejs: Staff: add or edit an event.
views/admin/attendance.ejs: Staff: attendance list for an event.
views/admin/scan.ejs: Staff: result of scanning a QR ticket.
views/admin/orgFields.ejs: The organization form fields, shared by the two pages above.
views/admin/seniors.ejs: Staff: find a senior, reset password, remove.
views/admin/report.ejs: Staff: one report with the conversation.
views/admin/onboarding-video.ejs: Staff: upload the welcome video and edit its transcript.
views/admin/system.ejs: Staff: is the database, SMS and upload service working?
views/emails/layout.ejs: The HTML wrapper for every email (used by src/services/notify.js).
views/partials/header.ejs: Top of every page: <head>, styles, scripts, the one-line header and the opening of <main>.
views/partials/footer.ejs: Bottom of every page: closes <main>, the dark footer, the log-out pop-up and closing scripts.
views/partials/seniorNav.ejs: The five-item menu (Home, Events, Seniors, Messages, My account), on top or at the bottom on phones.
views/partials/langToggle.ejs: The button that switches to the other language.
views/partials/flash.ejs: Shows the one-time green/red/blue message ("Welcome, Ade!").
views/partials/eventTile.ejs: The tall photo event card used in Home's "Events near you" (dark and light versions).
views/partials/eventCard.ejs: The event card used on Find events and the registered pop-up.
views/partials/eventImage.ejs: An event's picture: the uploaded photo, or the category cover photo.
views/partials/eventTags.ejs: Status tags like "Almost full" and "Closes in 3 days".
views/partials/loginModal.ejs: The log-in / sign-up pop-up when a guest taps Register.
views/partials/confirmLogoutModal.ejs: "Do you want to log out?" pop-up.
views/partials/authAside.ejs: Side panel used on forgot, reset and change password pages.
views/partials/ui/passwordInput.ejs: A password box with a lock icon and a show/hide eye button.
views/partials/ui/textInput.ejs: A text box with an icon on the left.
